apache/shenyu.about: Java-native API gateway for service proxy, protocol conversion and API governance.
apache/shenyu.did: Request-path cost in the gateway core: four hot-path helpers stopped allocating per request, the plugin timing key is built once in `after`, retries reuse an immutable backoff template, and `NettyHttpClientPlugin` copies upstream response headers natively instead of rebuilding them. Alongside, AI governance gained a schema-validated structured-output path with bounded repair and a normalized request view.

agentic-ai-java/argi.about: Agent Runtime and Graph Intelligence: a Java agent framework built on Spring AI, with a graph runtime, multi-agent workflows and visual administration.
agentic-ai-java/argi.did: Runtime lifecycle and publish-time validation: task registration is now mutually exclusive with shutdown and scheduled start/stop are atomic state transitions, workflow publishing rejects subflow reference cycles and mismatched IO schemas before a run can start, and persisted run-state gauges are freshness-gated. Model calls are bounded by a deadline-aware retry policy and a context-window budget.

agentscope-ai/agentscope.about: Build and run agents you can see, understand and trust - a Python framework for multi-agent applications.
agentscope-ai/agentscope.did: Background tool execution in the Python framework: offloaded tool placeholders carry structured metadata so a running job is distinguishable from a finished one, tools can opt out of offloading or override its timeout, and the realtime downlink pump restarts itself after a crash instead of going silent. Next: keeping the local workdir strictly inside the workspace base directory.
